commercial_billing_order_lines_period_pa.name: commercial_billing_order_lines_period_pair
commercial_billing_order_lines_period_pa.value: ("commercial_billing_order_lines"."billing_period_starts_at" IS NULL AND "commercial_billing_order_lines"."billing_period_ends_at" IS NULL) OR ("commercial_billing_order_lines"."billing_period_starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_billing_order_lines"."billing_period_ends_at" > "commercial_billing_order_lines"."billing_period_starts_at")

commercial_billing_orders_quote_expiry.name: commercial_billing_orders_quote_expiry
commercial_billing_orders_quote_expiry.value: "commercial_billing_orders"."expires_at" IS NULL OR ("commercial_billing_orders"."quoted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_billing_orders"."expires_at" > "commercial_billing_orders"."quoted_at")

commercial_offer_grants_duration_valid.name: commercial_offer_grants_duration_valid
commercial_offer_grants_duration_valid.value: ("commercial_offer_grants"."grant_type" = 'partner_benefit' AND ("commercial_offer_grants"."duration_days" IS NULL OR "commercial_offer_grants"."duration_days" > 0)) OR ("commercial_offer_grants"."grant_type" = 'trial' AND "commercial_offer_grants"."duration_days" > 0)

commercial_payments_scope_shape.name: commercial_payments_scope_shape
commercial_payments_scope_shape.value: ("commercial_payments"."billing_order_id" IS NULL AND "commercial_payments"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_payments"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("commercial_payments"."billing_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commercial_payments"."location_id" IS NULL AND "commercial_payments"."product_id" IS NULL AND "commercial_payments"."subscription_id" IS NULL AND "commercial_payments"."route_id" IS NULL)

commercial_products_price_pair.name: commercial_products_price_pair
commercial_products_price_pair.value: ("commercial_products"."price_minor" IS NULL AND "commercial_products"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("commercial_products"."price_minor" >= 0 AND "commercial_products"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("commercial_products"."currency")) = 3)

location_subscriptions_price_pair.name: location_subscriptions_price_pair
location_subscriptions_price_pair.value: ("location_subscriptions"."price_minor" IS NULL AND "location_subscriptions"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("location_subscriptions"."price_minor" >= 0 AND "location_subscriptions"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("location_subscriptions"."currency")) = 3)

location_subscriptions_billing_anchor_pa.name: location_subscriptions_billing_anchor_pair
location_subscriptions_billing_anchor_pa.value: ("location_subscriptions"."billing_anchor_day" IS NULL AND "location_subscriptions"."billing_anchor_is_end_of_month" IS NULL) OR ("location_subscriptions"."billing_anchor_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "location_subscriptions"."billing_anchor_is_end_of_month" IS NOT NULL)

customer_auth_tokens_target_valid.name: customer_auth_tokens_target_valid
customer_auth_tokens_target_valid.value: ("customer_auth_tokens"."purpose" = 'verify_email' AND "customer_auth_tokens"."signup_intent_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("customer_auth_tokens"."purpose" = 'login_link' AND "customer_auth_tokens"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

location_channel_grants_window.name: location_channel_grants_window
location_channel_grants_window.value: "location_channel_grants"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "location_channel_grants"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "location_channel_grants"."ends_at" > "location_channel_grants"."starts_at"

device_current_state_music_signal_check.name: device_current_state_music_signal_check
device_current_state_music_signal_check.value: ("device_current_state"."music_session_id" IS NULL AND "device_current_state"."music_sequence" IS NULL) OR ("device_current_state"."music_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "device_current_state"."music_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "device_current_state"."music_sequence" >= 0)

device_current_state_ambient_signal_chec.name: device_current_state_ambient_signal_check
device_current_state_ambient_signal_chec.value: ("device_current_state"."ambient_session_id" IS NULL AND "device_current_state"."ambient_sequence" IS NULL) OR ("device_current_state"."ambient_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "device_current_state"."ambient_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "device_current_state"."ambient_sequence" >= 0)

hourly_channel_playback_utc_hour_check.name: hourly_channel_playback_utc_hour_check

hourly_device_playback_utc_hour_check.name: hourly_device_playback_utc_hour_check
hourly_device_playback_utc_hour_check.value: date_trunc('hour', "hourly_device_playback"."bucket_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = ("hourly_device_playback"."bucket_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

hourly_error_aggregates_utc_hour_check.name: hourly_error_aggregates_utc_hour_check
hourly_error_aggregates_utc_hour_check.value: date_trunc('hour', "hourly_error_aggregates"."bucket_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = ("hourly_error_aggregates"."bucket_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

gift_access_invitations_revocation_shape.name: gift_access_invitations_revocation_shape
gift_access_invitations_revocation_shape.value: ("gift_access_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "gift_access_invitations"."revoked_by_operator" IS NULL) OR ("gift_access_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "gift_access_invitations"."revoked_by_operator" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("gift_access_invitations"."revoked_by_operator")) > 0)

gift_access_invitations_duration_shape.name: gift_access_invitations_duration_shape
gift_access_invitations_duration_shape.value: ("gift_access_invitations"."duration" = 'indefinite' AND "gift_access_invitations"."duration_months" IS NULL) OR ("gift_access_invitations"."duration" <> 'indefinite' AND "gift_access_invitations"."duration_months" IN (3, 6, 12))

gift_access_invitations_redemption_shape.name: gift_access_invitations_redemption_shape
gift_access_invitations_redemption_shape.value: ("gift_access_invitations"."redeemed_at" IS NULL AND "gift_access_invitations"."redeemed_organization_id" IS NULL AND "gift_access_invitations"."redeemed_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("gift_access_invitations"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "gift_access_invitations"."redeemed_organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "gift_access_invitations"."redeemed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

organization_channel_gift_grants_duratio.name: organization_channel_gift_grants_duration_shape
organization_channel_gift_grants_duratio.value: ("organization_channel_gift_grants"."duration" = 'indefinite' AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."duration_months" IS NULL AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."ends_at" IS NULL AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."billing_anchor_day" IS NULL AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."billing_anchor_is_end_of_month" IS NULL) OR ("organization_channel_gift_grants"."duration" <> 'indefinite' AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."duration_months" IN (3, 6, 12) AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."ends_at" > "organization_channel_gift_grants"."starts_at" AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."billing_anchor_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."billing_anchor_is_end_of_month" IS NOT NULL)

organization_channel_gift_grants_revocat.name: organization_channel_gift_grants_revocation_shape
organization_channel_gift_grants_revocat.value: ("organization_channel_gift_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."revoked_by_operator" IS NULL) OR ("organization_channel_gift_grants"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_channel_gift_grants"."revoked_by_operator" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("organization_channel_gift_grants"."revoked_by_operator")) > 0)
